FOR SALE BY PRIVATE TREATY
18, GANDON WALK, LUCAN, CO. DUBLIN. K78 E1H2.

To organize a viewing or to place a bid on this property go to www.teamlorraine.ie or scan the QR code on the photograph section of this brochure.

A3-Rated Family Home with Room to Grow | Team Lorraine Mulligan, RE/MAX Results

Brought to market by an award-winning Auctioneering Team with over 25 years` experience.

From the moment you step through the front door, this beautifully presented three-bedroom family home reveals itself as a rare find lovingly maintained, move-in ready, and full of untapped potential with an attic already converted. 

A Warm Welcome

Every room here has been finished with care. Large, bright and airy throughout, the home offers a genuine sense of space and light from the first room to the last the kind of interior that simply feels good to live in.

A Rare Find, Already Finished

Some homes come with potential. This one comes with the work already done. This beautifully presented three-bedroom semi-detached home also enjoys a full attic conversion a substantial addition that would cost a new owner in the region of 50,000 to 70,000 to undertake today, given current material costs and the scarcity of skilled tradespeople. Here, it`s simply included, finished, and ready to use.

Space That Actually Works For You

The converted attic isn`t just an extra room it`s been thoughtfully designed with generous additional storage and a walk-in wardrobe, the kind of practical luxury that`s genuinely hard to come by in homes of this size. It`s the difference between a house that fits your life today and one that grows with you tomorrow. Throughout the rest of the home, rooms are bright, well-proportioned and finished with care, offering a real sense of space from the moment you step inside.

Outdoor Living, Elevated

The rear garden has been designed with everyday living in mind, with a sunny sun trapped southeast facing patio offering flexibility for however you use the space. One sits directly off the kitchen/dining area, positioned to catch the sun ideal for morning coffee, weekend get-togethers, or long summer evenings outdoors. The back garden also has a steel garden shed which is ideal for bicycles and garden tools. Off-street parking for two cars adds to the home`s practicality.

Built to Perform

This home carries a BER A3 rating, meaning genuinely low running costs and strong energy performance day to day. It`s further supported by an EV charger and an upgraded solar setup. Buyers who qualify may also benefit from the Green Mortgage rate, adding a further layer of long-term value.

Gandon Walk Community That Delivers

Now in its fifth year, Gandon Walk has quickly built a name as one of Lucan`s most desirable addresses, known for its strong, family-focused community. 

Everything Close By

The location does a lot of selling itself. Two local playgrounds and the excellent Airlie Park are within easy walking distance, offering football, cricket, tennis and a newly built playground. Well-regarded schools and sports clubs serve the local GAA and athletics community. Day-to-day needs are covered by SuperValu, Lidl and a new shopping center, alongside a good spread of shops, cafés, bars and restaurants with Finnstown Castle Hotel on hand for something more special. A newly opened community center rounds out the local offering with regular events.

Local Amenities & Location

Lidl at Shackleton Park
Lucan Shopping Centre, including SuperValu
Hillcrest Shopping Centre, including Tesco
The Crossings, with Aldi, Tesco and Eurasia at Adamstown
Other nearby amenities include the Tandy`s Lane Park and Playground, along with a selection of primary and secondary schools, making the area particularly convenient for families.

Easy to Get To, Easy to Get From

Commuting is straightforward. Adamstown train station is walkable and puts Heuston Station just 12 minutes away, while Lucan Village is a scenic 20-minute walk in the other direction. The area is also well covered by Dublin Bus, with the C and L routes running every 10 15 minutes into Dublin city center in around 30 minutes.

A home where the hard work is already done. A home that has been cherished, in a community that will welcome you ready for its next chapter.

Accommodation briefly comprises of kitchen/dining room, utility room, hallway, guest W.C., sitting room, landing, three bedrooms (primary en-suite), family bathroom and an attic conversion.
